title: AICTEComplaintPair
description: Standardized schema for labelled complaint pairs in NyayaNiti duplicate detection pipeline

complaint_text_1.description: Normalized text content (title + description) of the first complaint

complaint_text_2.description: Normalized text content (title + description) of the second complaint

label.description: Binary duplicate classification label: 1 = Duplicate, 0 = Non-duplicate

multiclass_label.description: Taxonomy label: 0 = Distinct, 1 = True Duplicate Matter, 2 = Related Matter / Common Institution Overlap

verification_source.description: Ground truth verification origin (e.g., SEED_CANONICAL_DUPLICATE, STATUTORY_INSPECTION_RECORD, HUMAN_EXPERT_ANNOTATION)

annotator_id.description: Identifier of the legal/scrutiny officer who verified or annotated the pair

verification_notes.description: Statutory reasoning or rationale for the assigned duplicate/non-duplicate label
